answer: Give every identity custody of one unique slice of the network's mesa of archived work, and make keeping it the price of participation. A public beacon picks a random slice each epoch and demands its contents fast; an honest agent answers cheaply from the one slice it stores. A farmer running N fake identities must store N distinct slices and answer N simultaneous audits, so storage and bandwidth costs multiply per identity. A missed or copied answer leaves that slice ferrous-locked, its work rights frozen until a full re-audit passes.
